note: v1915: He asked for a cancelled cursor on terror zones that are not worth farming and for only the worthwhile ones to be clickable and routable. A thin zone was greyed and grayscaled and still routed, with a title that said open it anyway. This is the third reversal of the same decision and the whole thread is recorded rather than swapped in silence - v1588 made it inert, v1801 unlocked it because dropping the level term took thin from 15 of 66 to 40 of 66 and a lock over most of the map punishes him for a ranking rather than informing him of one, and he chose clickable at the time. He has now chosen the opposite, the consequence is unchanged and stated, and what v1588 never had is the cursor itself. The spec that pinned the old choice in four assertions is why this could not be accidental, and it pins the new one.
